description_en: Obtain the User ID attached to a device by the device's openID.
description_zh: 根据设备openID，获取设备绑定用户ID
name: GetUserByDeviceId

fields.help_en: Encoding type. Set this parameter to **PROJECT_ID**.
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en: The value corresponding to the encoding type. Set this parameter to the Project ID of the product’s ProductKey in the Tmall Genie AI platform.
fields.help_zh: 编码类型对应的值，此处填写天猫精灵AI平台中，该产品ProductKey所在项目的Project ID
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en:
Type of the device ID:  
- OPEN_ID: The default device ID.  
- UNION_ID: The organization-dimension device ID. You must request an organization on the Open Platform in advance.
fields.help_zh:
设备Id的类型
- OPEN_ID：默认的设备ID标识。
- UNION_ID: 组织维度的设备ID标识，需要提前在开放平台申请组织
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en: Device identifier, configured as either deviceOpenId or deviceUnionId.
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: Organization ID. Required if IdType is set to UNION_ID.
fields.name: organization_id
